id: title:jonmcwest:stamp the masked pattern onto the log record

review.posthog_relevance: Adds pattern and pattern_version fields to record payloads and interfaces, supporting downstream consumers and ClickHouse compatibility while distinguishing records written before and after masking.
review.reason: Adds PATTERN_VERSION import and uses it to stamp pattern and pattern_version onto records and the LogRecord interface. This supports downstream consumers and ClickHouse compatibility, and distinguishes records written before masking from those written after.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of metadata preservation and compatibility support. No evidence exists regarding actual downstream adoption, compatibility issues resolved, or specific benefit realization. The score does not account for unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds PATTERN_VERSION import and uses it to stamp pattern and pattern_version onto records.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds pattern and pattern_version fields to the record payload, preserving the pattern and its version alongside the masked body.
